title: Share the Symbol, Not the Vector: Training-Free Fact Communication Across Language Models
authors: Xin Li; Mengbing Liu; Hao Jiang; Xin Gao; Annan Wang; Xingwei Qu; Yichi Zhang; Chau Yuen
summary_zh: 免训练跨族事实通信：sender发送共享词表索引，receiver用自身词方向把事实写入隐状态
core_contribution_zh: sender只看描述、从共享词表选词并发送索引，receiver用一次性从自身激活拟合的词方向写入早期层隐状态；3个sender与5个家族的9个新receiver上，新场景四答全对率72.0–98.3%，比中层写入最高高96个百分点，最大两个receiver与纯文本持平；任务无关探针预先判对45/45个可用深度；多token地标任务23.9–64.0%（低于文本，无消息为0%）。
notes: Content controls: attribute-swap test requiring correct answers on both changed and unchanged attributes (4 answers); no-message baseline 0% on landmark task; HTML result tables include inject_shuffled and inject_wrongset arms. Wire = discrete indices into a shared word list (human-auditable), write = receiver-local latent directions, so it sidesteps vector translation that 2610.22026 finds collapses cross-family. Sender examples incl. Llama-3.1-8B, receivers Qwen3/Qwen3.5/Gemma-3 etc. (HTML). Project page https://lixin.ai/SYNC/ 200; GitHub 200; HF dataset 200.
verified: arXiv元数据✓；代码链接✓；引用滚雪球 2026-10-17

title: Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Shixuan Li; Wei Yang; Peiyu Zhang; Anzhe Cheng; Heng Ping; Paul Bogdan
summary_zh: 提出独立-通信-修订评测框架,审计文本与latent通信对答案修正/保持的影响
core_contribution_zh: ICR固定初始推理并设无消息对照,揭示相近精度背后修订行为差异巨大,通信质量非通道固有属性。
notes: Channel field approximate: audits both textual and latent channels.

title: Safety of Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Muhammad Huzaifa; Sina Mavali; Thorsten Eisenhofer
summary_zh: 显示训练sender→receiver可学习连接会削弱安全对齐,并提出RL攻击放大有害服从
core_contribution_zh: 发现仅用良性数学数据训练link也会抬高有害服从（文本4.4→latent 31.1等）；RL攻击将三拓扑平均有害服从分从27.9升至76.9，GRPO修复可从70.3压到4.8；MATH500 67.2→71.0、GPQA 36.4→33.6。未做内容对照，也未提出latent消息监控。
notes: Repo exists but README says code will be released soon.；精读订正(2026-10-15)：良性 link 用 SFT，攻击含 SFT 与 GRPO（training 列只能单值，记为 RL）。

title: LatCom: Cross-Agent Latent Compression for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration
authors: Shinan Zhang; Tao Zhang; Qihui Zhu; Mengjie Zhang; Dong Jin; Yunpeng Hou; Shuangwu Chen; Xiaobin Tan; et al.
summary_zh: 跨agent latent压缩:把多个sender的latent映射到固定数量receiver可读槽位
core_contribution_zh: 针对跨agent冗余提出两阶段训练压缩器(单sender可读性+多sender融合),较LatentMAS提速2.46倍、输出token降70.3%。

title: Emergent Specialization in Populations of Self-Supervised Collaborative Vision Experts Without a Shared Gate or Cross-Agent Gradients
authors: Aram Davtyan; Pablo Acuaviva; Sebastian Stapf; Paolo Favaro
summary_zh: 独立训练的视觉网络通过无梯度信道读取彼此内部状态求助，无中心门控下涌现分工
core_contribution_zh: DISCO中各agent本地选择helper、经无梯度信道读取其内部状态、仅按求助带来的提升奖励路由器；随机路由的群体不如单一generalist，语义路由群体超过它；被专家帮助的随机agent可追平solo generalist，本地路由器98%输入选中涌现专家。
subcategory: decentralized hidden-state help-seeking among vision experts
notes: Not LLMs: small vision networks fine-tuned with masked prediction of frozen DINOv3 features on 6 visual domains (proxy for predictive visual pretraining). Inter-agent channel is reading another agent's internal state via forward pass, no cross-agent gradients. Content control: randomly routed populations underperform a single generalist while semantically routed ones beat it -> gain comes from specialization, not population size. Initially identical agents (homogeneous architecture). Robust across population size, capacity, data imbalance, seeds. No code link in HTML. Cited C2C and KVCOMM.

title: Principled Thoughts for Latent Recursive LLM Systems
authors: Fahd Seddik; Fatemeh Fard
summary_zh: 为单/多agent latent递归系统提出表示监督目标,约束latent思维的四种性质
core_contribution_zh: 分析仅CE监督导致的四类latent思维失效,提出因果性、最小性、可分性、稳定性可微损失,提升latent单/多agent系统精度。

title: Compress What You See, Not What You Say: Anchored Context Distillation for Latent-Observation Software Engineering Agents
authors: Zhensheng Zou; Guoqing Wang; Dan Hao
summary_zh: 把SWE agent较早的工具观测压成soft token、自身动作保留文本，用锚定蒸馏让agent读取latent历史
core_contribution_zh: LOHA把旧工具观测压为soft token、保留agent自身回合与最近K条观测为文本，ACD把全文预测蒸馏进latent视图并锚定原行为；SWE-bench Verified上K=3时每次调用上下文减43%/57%（Qwen3-4B/SWE-Master-4B-RL），解决率12.1%/21.8%对未压缩基座14.5%/27.5%，32K上限下21.1%对全文11.1%，并发吞吐1.9倍。
subcategory: soft-token observation memory for SWE agents
notes: Only latent/soft-token channel found that is evaluated on a repo-level benchmark (SWE-bench Verified), but it is single-agent: the latent carrier holds the agent's own past observations, not messages between agents. Resolve rate drops 2.4-5.7 pp vs uncompressed at K=3. arXiv HTML has no code link (only references CoderForge-Preview dataset).

title: Controlling Collectives of AI Agents in Reasoning Space with Spatial Transformers
authors: Frederic Vatnsdal; Roshan Gopal; Romina Garcia Camargo; Vijay Kumar; Alejandro Ribeiro
summary_zh: 多机器人LLM集群中空间Transformer聚合多跳消息为学习型反馈token进行控制
core_contribution_zh: 提出去中心化reasoning-space反馈控制,用learned feedback token替代纯语言通信,随集群规模保持优势。

title: Machine-Interpretable Information: Compiling Documents into Searchable and Readable Protocol States
authors: Yifan Wang; Dejing Dou
summary_zh: 把文档编译成56-token规范latent状态，经轻量Translator供任意冻结异构LLM读取的A2A协议
core_contribution_zh: 状态空间Writer把文档编译为定长56 token的规范状态，Translator映射到任意冻结Reader的嵌入空间；Writer用GPT-2词表而Reader为Llama/Qwen/Mistral，实现跨族互通；实体表征可在无关文档状态间零样本移植且仍可解码；Residual-MII在HotpotQA（7,405问）上以约7%注意力FLOPs超过全上下文EM。
notes: Framed as 'the first agent-to-agent (A2A) document-to-state protocol', but the sender is a document compiler (Writer), not an agent acting in a task loop - closer to xRAG-style cross-model context compression. Content evidence: mechanistic probes show entity representations can be causally traced and zero-shot transplanted between document states and remain decodable (a content-transfer control). Cross-family: Writer uses legacy GPT-2 vocabulary, Readers Llama/Qwen/Mistral. Writer/Translator are trained; objective not detailed at abstract level (training=other). No code link in arXiv HTML. No coding tasks, no safety analysis.

title: AeroLat: Channel-Aware Latent Space Semantic Communication for Decentralized UAV Swarms
authors: Rajdeep Ghosh; Goparaju Venkata Seshachala Sree Vatsava; Sudip Misra
summary_zh: 发现同构冻结LLM广播的latent会坍缩到共享提示模板，用模板白化与证据注入修复并建模无线信道
core_contribution_zh: 指出同构冻结模型在离散感知输入下广播的隐藏状态向共享prompt模板坍缩（latent-swarm anomaly），以免训练、免协调的模板子空间白化与证据注入修复，并在带宽受限、噪声、陈旧等信道模型下评估；去掉白化的对照复现坍缩，虚假相似度降低97.5%。
subcategory: template-collapse of broadcast hidden states in swarms
notes: Directly relevant to 'does the latent actually carry content': raw broadcast latents of homogeneous frozen LLMs are dominated by the shared prompt-template subspace, so peers look falsely similar regardless of scene; no-whitening controls recover the collapse. Fix = linear projection removing top-m template subspace, derived independently by each agent. Raw latent = last k=8 hidden states (R^7168), Qwen-family backbone plus CLIP ViT-B/32 in PX4 simulation. Also reports a second collapse mechanism under fusion with channel impairments and a learned-compression protocol. 'Provably resilient' wording is about simulations. Semantic-communication/6G venue style -> adjacent by brief rule. No code link in HTML.

title: Portable Semantics, Private Dialects: Reuse and Negative Transfer in Latent Communication Between Language-Model Cells
authors: Narcis Marincat
summary_zh: 检验独立训练的LM细胞社会的连续latent包接口能否互通及迁移
core_contribution_zh: 发现独立训练社会的latent包语言不构成统一语言,跨初始化零样本对齐全部失败,继承接口可造成负迁移。
notes: Companion to arXiv:2608.20054.

title: From Semantic to Token Communication: The Next Paradigm for Large-Model-Driven 6G Intelligent Connectivity
authors: Yu Ma; Zhen Gao; Li Qiao; Xiaoyuan Zhang; Mahdi Boloursaz Mashhadi; Yin Xu; Wenjun Xu; Xiaodong Xu; et al.
summary_zh: 综述从大模型语义通信到以token为通信单元的TokenCom，含面向具身与agentic智能的token/KV传输
core_contribution_zh: 主张token是语义层面类似bit的通用单元，梳理LM驱动语义通信的三方向（信源语义编码、物理层信道语义、端边协同智能）与TokenCom所需传输技术，并讨论面向LM服务及具身/agentic智能的TokenCom；39页、182篇参考文献。
subcategory: 6G token-communication survey incl. agentic KV/latent exchange
notes: Bridge into the 6G/semantic-communication literature. Its agentic section covers latent multi-agent collaboration (e.g. MACF for long video, hybrid latent/NL protocols), Dai et al. token/KV media selection (2605.25422, already in index) and C2C. Useful payload figure quoted from Chen et al. (2603.28772, in index): ~88 KB per token for cache exchange vs 16 bytes for text, aggregated over four sharer models in a C2C-based setting. Submitted to Science China Information Sciences (arXiv comment). Not a primary source for numbers.

title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation
authors: Ziwu Liu; Guozhong Li; Chen Qiu; Weiyang Kong; Panos Kalnis
summary_zh: 大mentor编码一次、小student生成中定期刷新mentor潜在记忆，解决长文本中静态latent引导失效
core_contribution_zh: 多轮指令跟随上静态引导使4B student约束满足率比无引导低2.5点，每16 token免训练刷新只换记忆内容即恢复+2.0点；MentorPulse把mentor状态压入定长槽记忆、增量处理新生成token、经门控交叉注意供student读取，13个数据集上平均弥合52.2%的mentor-student差距，优于C2C、T2T与同预算LoRA，3个家族11对全部最佳。
notes: Mentor-student pairs are within-family (Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, Ministral 3; main pair Qwen3.5-27B->4B, HTML), so heterogeneous=no. Control: OracleSwap@16 changes only memory freshness (student weights, text, KV untouched). HTML: refreshed-text baseline rT2T reaches 33.7% recovery vs MP 52.2%; C2C 10.9%. Coding tag only because LiveCodeBench and BigCodeBench are among the 13 datasets (HTML). No code link.

title: What You Can't See Is What You Learn: Slot-Selective Evidence Masking Favors Compositional Generalization in Shared-Genome Language-Model Societies
authors: Narcis Marincat
summary_zh: 共享冻结LM的细胞社会仅靠连续向量中继通信,研究证据可见性对组合泛化的影响
core_contribution_zh: 显示限制各模块证据可见性的掩码训练使连续向量通信社会学到更可复用的值索引latent包,组合泛化提升≥20点。

title: Beyond the Transcript: Detecting Covert Co ordination in Latent Multi-Agent Communication
authors: Ramneet Kaur; Pradyumna Chari; Ramesh Raskar; Jugad Singh; Sumit Kumar Jha; Anirban Roy
summary_zh: 监控与引导agent间不可见的隐状态通道,检测latent通信中的隐蔽共谋
core_contribution_zh: 提出Verifiable Latent Alignments:三层监控(表示异常、反事实影响、SAE解释)与可引导性框架,同构AUROC 0.993。
notes: Directly addresses oversight of non-transcript latent channels.

title: StateBridge: Training-free Hidden-state Alignment for Latent Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Yanwen Peng; Delvin Ce Zhang; Xi Wang; Nikolaos Aletras
summary_zh: 闭式正交变换将sender末层隐状态对齐到receiver输入空间,作连续前缀免训练通信
core_contribution_zh: 提出免训练、可移植的隐状态对齐(正交映射+范数校准+词表锚定),在两族四模型26个模型-任务对中22个最佳。

title: XBridge: Entity-Grounded Latent Bridge for Heterogeneous LLM Communication
authors: Wooseong Yang; Wei-Chieh Huang; Weizhi Zhang; Yu Wang; Philip S. Yu; Junhyun Lee
summary_zh: 面向异构LLM的免解码通信,用词汇锚点映射加latent bridge缓解实体丢失
core_contribution_zh: 指出跨架构cross-attention桥存在稀有token压缩坍塌(实体身份丢失),提出Lexical Anchor Mapping与latent bridge结合的XBridge。

title: DH-VLM: Dual-Horizon Cooperative Latent Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
authors: Ziyi Song; Chen Xia; Hang Yu; Sheng Zhou; Zhisheng Niu
summary_zh: 路侧设施聚合多层隐状态形成全局latent引导,注入自车VLM进行协同规划
core_contribution_zh: 提出双视野协同latent推理与路侧驱动latent演化机制,并构建协同QA数据集,降低57.3%通信开销。

title: Post-Hoc Sparse Coding of Latent Communication Between Vision-Language Model Agents
authors: Di Wu; Xiaohui Zhu
summary_zh: 对Vision Wormhole的稠密latent消息事后拟合SAE,分析冗余并实现稀疏压缩传输
core_contribution_zh: 揭示固定容量稠密latent消息的有效信息密度低,事后稀疏编码可大幅压缩传输而保持下游效用。

title: How Far Do Simple Transformations Translate Across Text Embedding Models?
authors: Sid Ali Hamideche; Louis-Adrien Dufrène; Quentin Lampin; Guillaume Larue
summary_zh: 检验简单线性变换能否在异构文本嵌入模型间翻译表征，以评估AI间latent通信的可行性
core_contribution_zh: 在9个架构、池化方式与训练目标各异的文本嵌入模型间，以CKA、下游迁移、保真度与检索评估线性等轻量翻译器：部分兼容对能恢复共享结构并支持迁移，其他对则急剧失败；兼容性同时取决于架构、训练目标、池化与数据分布，异构嵌入空间并非普遍可由简单映射联系（摘要无具体数字）。
notes: All authors at Orange (telecom); explicitly framed as an enabler for AI-to-AI latent communication without decoding to text, hence semantic-communication tag. Embedding encoders, not generative agents. Counterweight to Platonic-convergence assumptions behind cross-family latent channels. v2 dated 2026-09-02. No code link.

title: Do Latent Channels Actually Communicate? A Causal Audit of Latent Multi-Agent LLM
authors: Huixiang Zhang; Mahzabeen Emu
summary_zh: 在sender表示进入receiver处做受控消息替换,因果审计latent通道是否真在传递信息
core_contribution_zh: 提出四种消息设置、五项指标的因果审计框架，但只审计了LatentMAS：总体效应=他例消息效应+内容效应(CAG)，二者可反号（Qwen3-4B GSM8K：−6.17 / +5.17pp），4B上MATH-500 CAG +6.67pp，到8B反转；样本小（每格40–100题）。
notes: Qwen3-4B/8B latent relay on GSM8K, ARC-C, MATH-500.；精读订正(2026-10-15)：首页 AAAI 2027 模板版权行不是录用证据。

title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models
authors: Wes Gurnee; Nicholas Sofroniew; Adam Pearce; Mateusz Piotrowski; Isaac Kauvar; Runjin Chen; Anna Soligo; Paul Bogdan; et al.
summary_zh: 用 Jacobian lens 找出模型准备说出口的表征（J-space），发现它具备全局工作区的功能与结构特征
core_contribution_zh: J-space 的内容可被报告、主动调出并保持，可承载无声推理的中间步骤，可作为参数传给下游计算；只在中间一段层中携带连贯内容，同一时刻约容纳几十个概念，并被权重更广泛地广播；在对齐审计中能揭示从未出现在输出里的策略性思考和评测意识。
subcategory: capacity-limited internal global workspace in a single LLM
notes: 这是单模型内部机制，收录理由是它可作为“隐式共享空间”的底座：如果要在 agent 之间共享 latent，J-space 给出了一个天然的“可广播、容量有限（约几十个概念）、位于中间层”的子空间，也是最有希望的监控窗口。对用户想法的含义：latent 论坛应写入或读出这一子空间，而不是整条残差流；而且 J-space 可读意味着隐式信道并非完全不可监控。作者还提出 counterfactual reflection training（training=other）。另见 Dehaene 与 Naccache 的评论；后续工作 2609.32102 把它推广到 Mamba 的循环状态。arXiv 作者共 16 人（Gurnee 至 Lindsey）。全文在 transformer-circuits.pub/2026/workspace（HTTP 200）。
verified: arXiv元数据✓；定向检索（shared memory / 支撑文献）2026-10-17

title: On the Role of Learned Alignment Matrices in LatentMAS
authors: Spursh Deshpande; Wenhao Lu
venue: ICML 2026 Workshop (2nd Workshop on Compositional Learning: Safety, Interpretability, and Agents)
summary_zh: 消融LatentMAS对齐矩阵：换成恒等矩阵无显著掉点，代码任务上文本MAS优于latent通信
core_contribution_zh: 三个推理基准上把对齐矩阵换成恒等变换无统计显著下降，去掉跨agent传递在数学/科学上持平或更好；代码生成上latent协作优于单agent但不如文本MAS，且谱匹配的随机矩阵反而优于训练所得矩阵，作者结论为文本通信在代码上仍更优（尽管慢得多）。
subcategory: ablation audit of LatentMAS incl. code
notes: No arXiv version found; evidence is the ICML 2026 virtual page abstract (OpenReview forum blocked by browser check), so per-task numbers not seen. Abstract calls the matrix "trained/learned" whereas LatentMAS W_a is a closed-form ridge solution — terminology discrepancy to check. Date approximated by workshop date (2026-07-11). One of the few works with a random-matrix control on code.

title: What Do Latent Agents Actually Represent? Interpreting Hidden-State Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Wenhao Lu; Spursh Deshpande
venue: ICML 2026 Workshop (2nd Workshop on Compositional Learning: Safety, Interpretability, and Agents)
summary_zh: 探针分析四agent latent MAS：任务身份近乎线性可分、角色可恢复，大部分表示空间未被使用
core_contribution_zh: 在数学、科学选择题与代码生成上分析四agent hidden-state通信：任务身份近乎完全线性可分、agent角色可近乎完美恢复，正确性信号峰值在中层但单agent基线也有，agent间信息高度冗余；结论是latent通信的“丰富性”主要反映基座几何而非学到的协调。
notes: Companion of the alignment-matrix ablation (same two authors). No arXiv; abstract-level evidence only; no per-task numbers available. Date approximated by workshop date.

title: Confidence Laundering in Agent Systems: Why Uncertainty Needs a Latent Carrier
authors: Kaiwen Shi; Zheyuan Zhang; Han Bao; Colby Nelson; Yanfang Ye
summary_zh: 立场论文：agent交接时上游不确定性被洗成干净工件，主张为交接附带latent不确定性载体
core_contribution_zh: 定义“不确定决策交接”与“置信洗白”：脆弱的上游状态被重新包装为程序上合规的中间工件，下游agent过度信任，局部歧义被放大为系统级错误；主张在交接上附加latent不确定性（不取代文本），把agent不确定性传播从逐步估计转向保留不确定性的接口设计（摘要无数字）。
notes: Latent uncertainty is defined as an actionable subset of hidden states attached alongside the text artifact (HTML). Validation experiments in a web-search tool-use setting with a small Qwen 1.5B model (HTML appendix); no numbers in abstract. Not a channel method; useful framing for why text handoffs lose information that a latent side-channel could keep. No code link.

title: Beyond tokens: a unified framework for latent communication in LLM-based multi-agent systems
authors: Yingzhuo Liu
summary_zh: 综述LLM多智能体latent通信,从传什么、如何对齐、如何融合三轴统一组织
core_contribution_zh: 用WHAT/WHICH/HOW三轴组织18篇代表工作+4篇边界工作，给出5条Takeaway、Table 4部署决策表、传输收支平衡式与7个研究议程；未讨论消息内容是否被使用的对照。
notes: Companion paper list: Awesome-Latent-Communication. Single author (Yingzhuo Liu).；精读订正(2026-10-15)：方法卡片有多处机制描述与作者归属错误（AC、Interlat、ThoughtComm 机制；CIPHER、C2C、LatentMAS、KVComm 等作者），适合作分类参考，不宜作事实来源。

title: Closing the Loop on Latent Reasoning via Test-Time Reconstruction
authors: Xiaopeng Yuan; Haibo Jin; Ye Yu; Peng Kuang; Lijun Yu; Yushun Dong; Haohan Wang
summary_zh: 测试时要求从latent思维重建原问题，以此校验latent是否保留任务约束，闭环优化latent推理

title: LACE: Lattice Attention for Cross-thread Exploration
authors: Yang Li; Zirui Zhang; Yang Liu; Chengzhi Mao
summary_zh: 在注意力输出上加跨线程“格点注意力”侧路，经合成数据SFT+多线程GRPO训练，让并行推理线程实时互享中间结论
core_contribution_zh: Lattice attention用3D RoPE（token位置+线程编号）让同一步的4个线程互相注意，新增参数<11%、FLOPs<1.3%；Qwen3-4B上AIME25/AIME24/LiveBench为20.0/20.0/41.8，对独立采样均值13.3/12.5/25.6、对同数据无格点层的Isolated Parallel为6.7/10.0/12.7；摘要称比标准并行搜索高7分以上。
notes: From HTML v3: Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, 4 threads, SFT (lattice-only then full) + Lattice GRPO with accuracy+diversity reward. Content control: no shuffled/corrupted-peer ablation; nearest control is 'Isolated Parallel' (same data & recipe, no lattice layers) which is often WORSE than independent sampling, so the gain is attributable to the cross-thread path, not the data. Paper's 'over 7 points' (abstract) vs 'up to 13' (intro) do not match its own Table 1 maxima. Cross-thread attention ratio on Parallel-R1 data = 0.00 vs 0.12 on their data: naturally occurring CoT data does not teach threads to use the channel. Cross-family: no. Long-horizon/SWE: no (math, LiveBench). Shared structure: every thread writes, every thread reads all peers at the SAME decoding step only (no access to peers' past or future); addressing by thread index in RoPE; fusion via learned sigmoid gate; synchronous, so no staleness/conflict handling. Safety/monitoring: not discussed; the channel is a non-verbal side path, so peer influence is not visible in any thread's text. Reports threads deferring to a correct peer (early stop). No code link found on arXiv page.；训练方式：SFT+RL

notes: From HTML v3 (rev. Feb 2026): attention across the batch axis at each token index, no positional encoding, no KV cache; active during prefill too. title: Coordination Among Neural Modules Through a Shared Global Workspace

title: Augment the Cache, Replace the Activation: A 2x2 Study of Internal-State Sharing
authors: Adam Deng; Shicheng Liu; Yada Zhu
summary_zh: 把多agent内部状态通信改为“发布到池、peer统一读取”，发现KV须增补、激活须替换
core_contribution_zh: 在统一对照阶梯下交叉比较KV与激活两种载体×增补/替换两种融合：KV须保留接收方自身cache、交叉注意peer cache，仅训练小型query侧adapter即达到直接读原文档的准确率；激活则直接写入接收方最好，无需桥接、adapter与训练。一个adapter训练一次即可服务未见过的publisher及多publisher池，但仅限内部状态接近接收方者（摘要未给具体数字）。
subcategory: carrier x fusion coupling (augment KV, replace activation)
notes: Content controls are central: no-op, position, mismatch (fact injected at wrong positions) and mis-source controls (HTML). Caveat reported by authors: the mismatch control is clean only at shallow layers and rises above floor at deeper layers where activation replacement works best; a trained activation arm that first looked strongest failed the mis-source control. Cross-family sharing (GPT-Neo-1.3B holder -> Qwen2.5-1.5B receiver via frozen SVD projection) collapses to floor on both carriers (HTML), hence heterogeneous=yes but negative. Main holder/receiver = same frozen Qwen2.5-1.5B; one split-context SQuAD factual-recall probe. Training: KV arm = small query-side adapter; activation arm training-free. Companion to 2610.22016 (same authors). No code link on abs/HTML.

title: Close Enough is Nowhere Near: Fidelity-Consumability Decoupling in KV Caches
authors: Adam Deng; Shicheng Liu; Yada Zhu
summary_zh: 冻结双模型下用sender KV替换reader cache行不通：几何相似不预测可用性，增补式读取才有效
core_contribution_zh: 对8种替换式方法与两个实测锚点（无信息cache基线、reader读原文的准确率）比较，全部停在基线；提出reader“可容忍集”与竞争性注意力解释，几何相似度不预测可用性且失败非渐进；改为保留自身cache、把sender cache作附加上下文并只适配query，可超过自身基线，8个sender池化仍高于基线，而无定向注意同一并集则跌破基线。
subcategory: substitution vs augmentation; reader tolerable set
notes: Directly tests whether a substituted latent carries content: floor = reader's own cache with answer masked, plus mis-sourced negative control (HTML). HTML details beyond abstract: cosine orders a noise cache and a genuine cache backwards; corrupting one of 28 layers is as damaging as all; nearest of 6,000 genuine keys still fails; 7-reader cross-architecture check (Pythia, GPT-2, Qwen2.5). Augmentation arms use a second instance of the same checkpoint; only one cross-family arm (GPT-Neo-1.3B sender), so heterogeneity evidence is thin. Authors scope it as 'a characterization on one probe, not a leaderboard claim'. Training-free refers to substitution arms; augmentation trains a query-side adapter. Same authors as 2610.22026.

title: To Cache or Not to Cache: Understanding and Mitigating Safety Incompatibility in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse
authors: Zhiwei Lin; Jiahao Liu; Yan Liu; Chengpeng Wang

authors: Wei Song; Yuxin Cao; Xi Zheng; Leo Zhang; Xiao Cheng
summary_zh: 揭示共享KV层只按token内容键控会抹去适配器/权重/共享域等来源信息，导致不兼容KV被错误复用
core_contribution_zh: 首次系统研究“来源盲复用”：审计3个vLLM连接器并在vLLM与两版SGLang、7个家族12个模型(0.5B–32B)、160+配置上复现；跨适配器碰撞使准确率0.94→0.64，不兼容KV使推理准确率降为0，缺盐使计时侧信道识别93%提示；提出KV来源契约与差分检查器，命中路径延迟变化≤0.34ms。
subcategory: provenance-bound keys for shared KV tiers
notes: Not a MAS paper, but the most direct evidence found on ADDRESSING/CONFLICT failures of a shared KV store: if keys are content-only, entries from incompatible computational contexts (different LoRA adapter, weights, sharing domain) silently collide. Directly relevant to any 'latent forum' where many agents (possibly different adapters) write to one KV tier. Content control: effectively yes — cross-adapter/incompatible-KV injection acts as a mismatched-memory condition (0.94->0.64; reasoning -> 0). Cross-family: experiments span 7 families (but sharing across families is the failure, not a feature). Long-horizon/SWE: no. Shared structure: writer = any worker; addressing = token-content hash (+coarse model metadata) in current connectors; fix = injective keys over a declared provenance-dimension registry, canonical descriptor per request/worker; staleness not addressed. Safety: timing side channel from salt omission enables 93% prompt identification. No code link on arXiv page.

title: KVCMAS: Efficient KV cache Correction for Shared Context in Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Hyesung Jeon; Hyeongju Ha; Seoyoung Lee; Beomseok Kang; Jae-Joon Kim
summary_zh: 多agent共享上下文时在线校正因agent前缀不同导致的KV差异,减少重复prefill
core_contribution_zh: 提出在线KV校正框架,无需工作流外参考cache即可处理首次出现的共享上下文。

title: Draft-KV: Learning Useful Latent Communication Between Language Models
authors: Linquan Wu; Shichang Meng; Tianxiang Jiang; Haoyu Yang; Peng Zhong; Fengming Zhu; Xi Peng; Linqi Song; et al.
summary_zh: 发送sender起草答案时形成的KV,经门控侧记忆注入冻结receiver,并检验消息因果作用
core_contribution_zh: 先审计C2C与LatentMAS：消息换成他题消息后准确率至多变0.60pp（系统增益最高15.44pp）；Draft-KV以1.05M参数传草稿位置KV，Public协议配对增益P均值25.65pp，但传的主要是sharer的答案，Private协议系统增益仅2.51pp。
notes: Sharer Qwen3-8B to receiver Qwen2.5-0.5B (same vendor family, different generations).；精读订正(2026-10-15)：页眉称已被 ICLR 2027 接收，但附匿名评审 artifact 且 ICLR 2027 尚未放榜，按投稿处理。

title: PReCache: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA Agents via Low-Rank Precomputation and Neutral Reconstruction
authors: Hyesung Jeon; Hyeongju Ha; Jae-Joon Kim
summary_zh: 多LoRA agent共享基座KV并预计算各自低秩cache，避免沿用前一agent适配器状态而削弱角色
core_contribution_zh: 指出直接复用前一agent的cache会让当前agent依赖前者LoRA产生的状态、削弱自身角色行为；PreLRShared在共享上下文首次处理时预计算各agent的低秩cache，TTFT最高加速3.1倍、单请求吞吐提升2.3倍；ReBaseShared从无适配器隐状态重建中性基座cache，相对不共享平均仅降1.1点。
notes: Benchmarks HotpotQA and ScienceQA (AutoAct setup) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Ministral-8B-Instruct (HTML); no coding task. Useful as evidence of role leakage through a shared cache: the previous agent's adapter-shaped states contaminate the next role. Close to LRAgent (2602.01053, in index). No code link.

title: LLMs are General Asynchronous Agents
authors: George Yakushev; Denis Mazur; Vladimir Bartenev; Vyacheslav Zhdanovskiy; Timofey Byzov; Vladimir Kaurkin; Vadim Pastushenko
summary_zh: 推理协程各写自己的KV/递归状态块、通过可配置“cache view”读取他人块，实现免训练的异步并发agent
core_contribution_zh: AsyncLLM把KV与GDN递归状态切成CacheBlock，前向时写一块、读一组有序块视图（沿用Hogwild式只旋转query），Qwen3.5/3.6系模型无需训练即可做流视频、游戏、日志监控；1×H200上1→8协程吞吐9B模型106→552 tok/s；DevOps-Gym监控35B-A3B准确率61.76%→55.88%但前向次数8452→3837。
subcategory: inference coroutines with shared, view-addressed cache blocks
notes: Hogwild!-lineage system (cites Rodionov et al. 2025 for query-only rotation; related earlier work by overlapping authors: 'Asynchronous Reasoning: Training-Free Interactive Thinking LLMs', 2512.10931). Most explicit ADDRESSABLE shared-KV substrate found: each coroutine owns a CacheBlock (writer = owner), reads go through an ordered 'cache view' over other blocks (routing = which blocks are in the view; asymmetric visibility possible, e.g. writer sees thinker but not vice versa). Paper states the resulting state is 'not equivalent to any sequential inference, but remains legible to the LLM' — i.e., no consistency guarantee; no conflict/staleness mechanism beyond view order. Hybrid GDN layers composed as affine transforms in view order (order-dependent). Content control: none (no shuffled/foreign-block control). Cross-family: no. Long-horizon/SWE: DevOps-Gym log monitoring (34 tasks) shows accuracy LOSS vs sequential with ~2-3x fewer forward passes; no coding benchmark; self-defined coroutines 'not yet reliable', self-modifying agents needed sandboxing; without anti-distraction prompt 35B-A3B fell below 10% on monitoring. Fig.1 shows two sub-agents sharing cache blocks on math (illustrative). Model names as printed in paper (incl. 'Qwen3.8-27B'). GitHub HEAD 200.

title: EfficientAgent: What Makes KV Cache Offloading Work for Concurrent Agents?
authors: Kunming Shao; Jierun Chen; Jiangnan Yu; Xiao-Hui Li; Chaofan Tao; Yanli Wang; Huanxin Lin; Kwang-Ting Cheng; et al.
summary_zh: 用“复用工作集”解释KV卸载对并发agent时好时坏，并据此配置与管理host内存层
core_contribution_zh: 指出agent等待工具时服务器在处理其他agent，前缀只有在host层装下全池“复用工作集”时才能被复用；用stack-distance模型估算工作集并配置host层，在SWE-bench Verified编码agent上重算prompt token减93%、端到端时间减39%，小固定层下运行时策略仍减35%重算。
notes: Concurrent SWE agents share one server and a host KV tier but never read each other's cache (private prefixes); lossless. Repo HEAD 200.

title: Budgeted Cache Repair for Cross-Context KV-Cache Reuse
authors: Haeyong Kang; Chang D. Yoo
summary_zh: 跨上下文KV复用并非无损：在单行粒度而非整次调用上选择重算，按固定预算修复cache
core_contribution_zh: 发现跨上下文KV复用在MMLU、GSM8K上有明显准确率代价，且任何“是否复用”的决策规则都无法消除；知情选择在单行粒度去除49.5%超出随机的cache误差，64-token块仅10.6%，整次调用为0；BCR用从拼接cache起草的两个token的注意力排序cache行并精确重算固定预算行，GSM8K恢复到稠密prefill准确率且多数调用仍走cache，并胜过同预算抛硬币选择器。
subcategory: budgeted recomputation for cross-context KV reuse
notes: Setting is KVCOMM-style multi-agent reuse (three agents + aggregator sharing segments; baselines KVCOMM-style reuse and CacheBlend, HTML), and it disputes the 'no quality loss' claim. Includes a coin-flip selector control that prior evaluations lacked. Coding tag: HumanEval on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, where reuse caused little degradation (HTML). Models Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B. No code link.

title: Prefill-Free Cross-Family KV Cache Transfer for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent LLMs
authors: Vincent-Daniel Yun; Woosang Lim; Haneul Yoo; Sungjoo Yoo; Murali Annavaram; Sai Praneeth Karimireddy
summary_zh: 冻结异构sender/receiver,对齐结构、映射并校准sender KV实现免prefill跨家族传递
core_contribution_zh: 提出免prefill跨家族KV迁移,处理分词、层数与KV表示差异,在长上下文基准最佳且较原生prefill快10.7倍。

title: RR-Evict: Fine-Grained Prefix Cache Eviction beyond LRU for Agentic LLM Serving
authors: Zaifeng Pan; Chris Wu; Zhengding Hu; Xinwei Qiang; Zhongkai Yu; Yufei Ding
summary_zh: 指出LRU下agent历史的近因同步使驱逐集中于少数agent，提出轮询尾部驱逐
core_contribution_zh: 发现agent访问会同步刷新其历史节点，使LRU驱逐集中到少数agent的私有历史并造成TTFT离群；RR-Evict轮询各空闲轨迹并只驱逐尾部块，在SGLang的对话与编码agent负载（共置与PD分离）上P99 TTFT最多降75.4%、P99未缓存prompt token最多降65.7%。
notes: Same group as KVFlow (Pan, Ding). Lossless; no accuracy. No repo link found.

title: Receiver-Conditioned Latent Communication gives 94% CacheBack
authors: Maximillian Rossi; Prajwal Raghunath; Haoqing Xuan; Yusen Zhang; Eugene Wu
summary_zh: 接收方说明信息需求,用sender注意力筛选压缩KV-cache再传递的免训练通信
core_contribution_zh: 提出receiver-conditioned communication,在FanOutQA上去除75%传输状态同时提升精度与延迟。

title: Task-Oriented Key-Layer KV Communication for Efficient Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration
authors: Dongsen Zhang; Peipei Li; Zekun Li; Wenjun Xu
summary_zh: 以receiver轨迹失真准则选关键层,仅传该层latent工作记忆的免训练KV通信
core_contribution_zh: 把latent通信目标由sender保真转为receiver任务充分性,通信量降28–36倍,精度最高+23.3点。
notes: arXiv id 2610.x but v1 dated 2026-09-24.

title: KVShareArena: KV-Cache Reuse Across Contexts and Model Checkpoints
authors: Xi Shi; Mengxin Zheng; Qian Lou
summary_zh: 统一评测跨上下文与跨模型检查点KV-cache复用的基准与开放评测框架
core_contribution_zh: 提供2150题、6个LLM对、11种修复/压缩方法与四维成本质量评估,发现复用损失与有效修复依赖具体模型。

title: LatentPort: Beyond KV Cache - Cross-Model Transfer of Recurrent Memory in Hybrid Language Models: A 4B-to-9B Hybrid-State Handoff Without Target Prefix Replay
authors: Simon P. Villani
summary_zh: 在混合架构模型间迁移KV之外的循环记忆状态：Qwen3.5 4B→9B无需目标端重放前缀
core_contribution_zh: 仅翻译注意力KV留下大差距，加入Gated DeltaNet持久状态后teacher-forced NLL降0.747 nats/token，64篇PG19文档全部改善；直接复用循环与卷积状态优于学到的GDN映射；再加434,176参数修正后，续写损失仅比原生9B高0.076 nats/token、JS散度0.022、原生上下文恢复率0.918，零历史前缀token即显著优于继续用4B推理。
notes: Single architecture-matched sibling pair, one direction, 4K teacher-forced continuation; author states the near-native gate failed, 16K branch not run, free-generation equivalence unproven. Point for the field: hybrid/linear-attention models carry state outside the KV cache, so KV-only channels miss it. No code link.

title: CacheBridge: Efficient Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer
authors: Xingyu Qu; Siyuan Lu; Zhiyu Chen; Sheng Wang; Tao Lin
summary_zh: 改进闭式跨模型KV映射：目标头只配匹配源头，并按因果注意力敏感度加权校准
core_contribution_zh: 相对Full-Head Mapping，CacheBridge限定按架构索引的映射支撑、以注意力敏感度加权重建误差、用融合GPU核构造充分统计量；恢复了Full-Head在Ministral 3两个方向上的大幅掉点，Qwen3上保持99.83%平均目标保留率；Qwen3 14B→32B映射存储降8倍、应用加速至多3.0倍、只需1/10校准数据，500条序列构造从92.63秒降到8.63秒（10.7倍）。
notes: Within-family (Qwen3, Ministral 3). Follow-up to 2608.03893; serving-oriented. No content control beyond target retention. No code link.

title: A Universal Context-Reuse Layer for Cross-Model KV Sharing
authors: Yi Li; Dongming Jiang; Yi Zhao; Bingzhe Li
summary_zh: 通用上下文复用层:把源模型KV翻译为不同规模/架构/分词器目标模型可用表示
core_contribution_zh: 研究跨模型KV共享,在同族与跨族设置下翻译KV以免重复prefill,并提升目标模型长上下文精度。

title: TOPAS: Workflow-Aware Prefix-State Scheduling for Multi-Agent LLM Serving
authors: Hongqiu Ni; Han Tian; Chi Zhang; Guopeng Li; Haisheng Tan
summary_zh: 在共享KV预算下联合决定保留哪些agent前缀与调度哪些请求，缩短多agent工作流完成时间
core_contribution_zh: TOPAS按任务最长剩余服务路径缩减与下游前缀复用收益（计入迁移与抢占代价）为候选状态打分，并加任务级aging防饥饿，实现于SGLang；合成DAG上mean/p99 JCT最多降39.8%/49.4%，MetaGPT-SOP上mean JCT降9.8%，MetaGPT-TL上mean/p99降22.0%/26.6%。
subcategory: prefix-KV retention scheduling for agent DAGs
notes: Coding link: two of the five workloads are MetaGPT software-development workflows (SOP and TL variants). Exact prefix reuse of per-agent system prompts - lossless, so no accuracy/content question; pure serving efficiency. 8 pages. No code link in HTML. Cited KVCOMM.

title: Dual-Cache Latent Space Communication between Heterogeneous Language Models
authors: Jiyao Liu; Qi Zhang; Yaoyi Jia; Ziwen Kan; Song Wang
summary_zh: 双cache池化与逐位置检索,将sharer KV翻译到异构receiver的原生KV几何
core_contribution_zh: 同时池化sharer与receiver cache并用共享位置解码器逐位置检索残差,支持层数、KV头与分词器不同的冻结模型。

title: Aborted but Not Forgotten: KV-Cache Retention Breaks Rollback Consistency in Language Agents
authors: Guijia Zhang; Harry Yang
summary_zh: 应用层回滚只清除了transcript，服务端保留的KV仍让模型注意到已丢弃内容，破坏“回滚一致性”
core_contribution_zh: 形式化回滚一致性并提出同token/不同cache审计：决策步token完全相同、只改前缀cache是过时还是由已提交状态重建；7个开源家族(3.8B–36B)中仅保留KV就在63个审计格中翻转25个受保护效应（攻击者token全部不在请求中），重建cache全部关闭，事务级cache恢复无需全局清空。
subcategory: stale retained KV state vs logical rollback
notes: Single-agent serving study, but the cleanest evidence found on STALENESS of latent memory: the attended KV state and the visible transcript can diverge, and the divergence changes decisions while being invisible to the application. Content control: YES — same-token/different-cache audit (identical decision tokens, stale vs rebuilt prefix) isolates cache effects from text effects; position/length confounds ruled out. Cross-family: tested across 7 open-weight families (susceptibility varies; structural violation). Long-horizon: stateful agent sessions incl. LangGraph time-travel and default HF Transformers cache-reuse path; no SWE benchmark. Shared structure: writer = serving session; addressing = retained prefix; the failure is exactly a stale-read on a latent store; fix = transaction-local cache restoration. Safety/monitoring: a monitoring blind spot — transcript-level audit cannot see retained-KV influence; directly relevant to any implicit KV 'forum' where agents abort/redo work (common in long-horizon SWE). Abstract says headline results are reproducible from released artifacts; no repository link found on the abs page (code_open=announced).

title: When Does Latent Communication Pay? A Causal Audit of Relayed KV Caches in Multi-Agent LLMs
authors: Jiaming Cheng; Subhransu Das; Rajiv Ramnath
summary_zh: 以错配/置零/随机cache替换,因果检验已发布系统中中继KV是否带来样例特定信息
core_contribution_zh: 预注册错配cache审计LatentMAS/KVComm/C2C：receiver需要sender私有信息时配对效应近天花板；标准benchmark上LatentMAS配对效应经TOST限定在±2.8pp内；KVComm部分传递(+7~+11pp)，C2C检测不到样例特定传递；latent-only接口两臂均≈3.5%。
notes: Abstract says the mismatched-cache audit is released; no URL verified.；精读订正(2026-10-15)：仅 C2C 一格为异构（Qwen2.5-7B→Qwen3-8B），其余为同权重。

title: Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse
authors: Taekyung Heo; Rasoul Shafipour; Ritchie Zhao; Maximilian Golub; Mohammad Mahdi Kamani; Ritika Borkar; Makesh Tarun Chandran; Pantea Zardoshti; et al.
summary_zh: 同族不同尺寸模型间KV有大量线性结构，用闭式逐头岭回归映射让接收方跳过prefill
core_contribution_zh: Qwen3 14B→32B上单个源层解释目标key方差56%、value方差32%，多源层升至79%/65%；逐头闭式岭回归（选top-k源层、去RoPE、500条×1,024 token校准）在3个家族6对中4对保留接收方73–98%的独立prefill准确率，另2对急剧退化，非线性MLP在HellaSwag上可回收至多+37pp；映射比重新prefill快2.7–25倍，多轮交接稳定。
notes: Within-family only (Qwen3, Ministral, Llama 3.1; HTML). 'Training-free' = closed-form ridge fit on calibration data, no gradient training. Called 'Full-Head Mapping' by CacheBridge (2609.00891). 2610.22016 notes this line evaluates under redundancy (receiver could recompute the context) rather than information asymmetry. No code link.

title: KV Cache Translation across Heterogeneous Large Language Models
authors: Jin-woo Lee; Minkyung Song; Junghyun Oh; Seunghoon Han; Gwangseon Jang; Soyoung Park; Sungsu Lim
summary_zh: Mixture-of-Translators以token级路由将源LLM上下文KV翻译到目标LLM的cache空间
core_contribution_zh: 提出多翻译器路由与Context Correction Loss,使异构模型可复用彼此KV,减少重复prefill与存储。

title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
authors: Banruo Liu; Haoran Qiu; Íñigo Goiri; Rodrigo Fonseca; Ricardo Bianchini; Esha Choukse
summary_zh: 首个生产规模GitHub Copilot编码agent负载刻画：轮内KV命中约90%、跨轮降至55%
core_contribution_zh: 基于2026年6月抽样的Copilot轨迹（320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用、95T token），发现轮内KV命中率平均90%、跨轮边界降至55%，模型切换或上下文压缩会使缓存大面积失效；所设计的轻量空闲时间预测器可捕获86–90%的总空闲时间。
notes: Microsoft industrial study; no data release stated. Model switches and compaction invalidate KV — the practical reason cross-model KV translation (RaReCache) matters for coding agents.

title: MaSRead: Content-Addressed Reading of Replicated Latent Stores
authors: Carlos Baquero; Luís Brito; João Resende
summary_zh: 独立agent把KV片段经CRDT合并为复制latent存储，以内容寻址标签路由实现后续查询的选择性读取
core_contribution_zh: 指出CRDT合并后的KV片段共置会互相干扰（共置不等于可寻址）；MaSRead用由片段词导出的不透明标签集路由、在硬注意力掩码下逐片段解码，词汇连通时图游走可达多跳所需片段；在链式、流水线、对称、hub与自然语言存储上能孤立恢复访问片段，无关片段累积时仍有效，并可迁移到另一模型家族（摘要无具体数字）。
subcategory: content-addressed reads of CRDT-merged KV stores
notes: Training-free and deterministic; readers Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B and Llama-3.x (HTML). 'Transfers to another model family' = method replicates with another family's reader, not cross-family fragment sharing. Stated limits: lexical routing misses disconnected evidence; tags still expose equality, co-occurrence and access patterns (pseudonymized, not private) - relevant to auditing shared latent stores. Same authors as CanonicalMerge (2607.01308) and KV Integrity (2606.28958), both in index. API v1 date 2026-07-21 despite 2608 id. No code link.

title: Learning Agent Execution for KV-Cache Management in Agentic Serving
authors: Rui Zhang; Chaeeun Kim; Shaoting Feng; Kuntai Du; Yuhan Liu; Yi Zhong; Cheng-Wei Ching; Junchen Jiang; et al.
summary_zh: 在线学习agent执行转移以预测前缀复用，指导多agent服务中的KV驱逐与预取
core_contribution_zh: 不依赖预定义工作流图或离线训练，在线学习agent执行转移并据此做驱逐与主动预取；vLLM上KV命中率提升10–18个百分点、平均TTFT降18–45%、单轮延迟降29–38%、峰值吞吐最多+57%，更大模型上TTFT最多降54%。
notes: Per arXiv HTML: six-agent AutoGen SelectorGroupChat on GSM8K, MT-Bench, GAIA and SWE-bench; SWE-bench with Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 gives TTFT -33-54%. No accuracy reported (exact reuse). No repo link found.

title: [AAFLOW+] Stateful Operator Abstraction with Zero-Copy Distributed KV Cache Orchestration for Multi-Agent Workflows
authors: Arup Kumar Sarker; Alexander James Halpern; Mills Staylor; Aymen Alsaadi; Gregor von Laszewski; Yue Cheng; Shantenu Jha; Geoffrey Fox

title: LaneRoPE: Positional Encoding for Collaborative Parallel Reasoning and Generation
authors: Gabriele Cesa; Thomas Hehn; Aleix Torres-Camps; Àlex Batlle Casellas; Jordi Ros-Giralt; Arash Behboodi; Tribhuvanesh Orekondy
venue_evidence: https://iclr.cc/virtual/2026/10016650 (Poster in Workshop: Latent & Implicit Thinking – Going Beyond CoT Reasoning)
summary_zh: 用跨序列注意力掩码+扩展RoPE编码跨lane相对位置，让best-of-N的N条序列生成时互相协作

notes: Important cautionary data point (from HTML v1): most of the gain over base comes from KTO training itself (N=1 already 63.0); cross-lane attention adds only ~1.1 pt at 7B (N=4 vs N=1) and nothing at 1.5B. Head-to-head with Bridge (2510.01143, reimplemented) and Hogwild! official code (21.8, verbose outputs hitting 4096-token cap) under the same budget. Content control: no masked/shuffled-lane control in trained models; only init ablations (GroupThink vs NTK), SFT vs KTO. Untrained GroupThink-initialized models produce many corrupted completions. Cross-family: no. Long-horizon/SWE: no (MATH500/AIME/AMC). Shared structure: every lane writes to its own KV region; every lane reads all others via inter-sequence mask; relative cross-lane distance encoded by RoPE extension with learnable frequencies; synchronous decoding, no conflict/staleness handling. Context grows ×N. Safety/monitoring: not discussed. N<=4 only. No code link on arXiv page.；训练方式：SFT+other

subcategory: multi-stream decoding with cross-stream causal attention

Relevance to the 'thought forum' idea: shows a single forward pass can host many concurrently-written streams that read each other with a one-step delay, and that splitting roles into streams IMPROVED monitorability (concerns surfaced in readable internal streams) and injection robustness — a counterweight to the worry that concurrency kills oversight, but only because every stream stays textual. Shared structure: all agents read/write the same LoRA during training; routing = learned slot masks per role-context; conflicts handled only implicitly by slot separation; no test-time update, so no staleness. subcategory: population-based LoRA evolution on a shared frozen base
notes: Relevant to the user's 'group evolution' framing: the population shares a frozen base and exchanges information only through weight-space crossover of LoRA adapters (parametric gene-sharing) plus cross-evaluation — no messages. Single agent self-calibrates to easy problems; population sustains an arms race (problem coverage keeps expanding). Content control: compute-matched single-agent baseline; no control with random/shuffled crossover partners in the abstract. Cross-family: no. Long-horizon/SWE: no (function-level code benchmarks + math). Shared structure: writer = evolutionary operators (mutation/crossover) over adapters; no concurrent online memory, so no staleness. Safety: not addressed. Base model reported by secondary sources as Qwen2.5-Coder-7B (not verified on primary page). PyPI 'populora' is an unofficial third-party implementation; no official code link found.

notes: 订阅就是 agent 的 system prompt，即自然语言意图；broker 用 text-embedding-3-small 给消息和订阅的相容度打分，难例改用 LLM 选择；Reactive Subscription 由 LLM 根据刚收到的消息改写订阅，经同伴确认后可升入全局池。这是用户关心的“订阅机制”的现成实现，路由信号是 embedding 相似度，属于半隐式。基准含 HumanEval（91.5，AFlow 为 91.0），但没有长程 SWE。可扩展到 20 个 agent 左右，完整范围未写明。数字来自 HTML 摘读。

title: An Information Theoretic Perspective on Agentic System Design
authors: Shizhe He; Avanika Narayan; Ishan S. Khare; Scott W. Linderman; Christopher Ré; Dan Biderman
summary_zh: 把小模型压缩上下文、大模型据此预测的agentic系统视为噪声信道，用互信息衡量压缩质量
core_contribution_zh: 提出上下文与其压缩文本之间互信息的简单估计器，任务无关地预测下游表现；5个数据集×3个模型族显示扩大compressor比扩大predictor更有效，7B Qwen-2.5 compressor比1.5B准确1.6倍、简洁4.6倍、每token互信息多5.5倍；Deep Research中3B本地compressor以26% API成本恢复前沿模型99%准确率。
notes: Gives a task-independent, information-theoretic measure of how much context content survives a text handoff between models - a candidate metric for comparing text vs latent channels on equal footing ('bits per token'). Explicitly motivated by Deep Research and Claude Code-style multi-LM systems (coding is a motivating example, not an evaluated task; datasets LongHealth, FinanceBench, QASPER, WildChat, FineWeb). Cross-family pairs: Qwen/Llama compressors with GPT-4o / Llama predictors. Appendix D.7 lists compression failure modes. No code link found in HTML. Hazy Research (Ré).

title: Cost-Effective Communication: An Auction-based Method for Language Agent Interaction
authors: Yijia Fan; Jusheng Zhang; Kaitong Cai; Jing Yang; Chengpei Tang; Jian Wang; Keze Wang

authors: Deborah Sinishaw; Qile Zhu; Edwin Meriaux; Gregory Dudek
summary_zh: 构建一次性无通信博弈基准，告知对手是同一模型，检验13个LLM自博弈能否超越Nash基线
core_contribution_zh: 发现两个前沿托管模型在七类二人矩阵博弈中稳定超越Nash基线并接近最优联合结果，多数开源模型收益有限；四人以上可互换团队博弈中该能力明显退化。
notes: Comments: submitted to 2026 IEEE MIT URTC (undergraduate conference); not confirmed accepted.

title: Do LLMs Take Care of Their Own? Similarity Signals Can Induce Cooperation
authors: Akash Kundu; Emanuel Tewolde; Ratip Emin Berker; Samuel F. Brown; Vincent Conitzer
summary_zh: 提出首个评测框架：向LLM提供分级相似度信号，检验其是否因与对手“相似”而在合作困境中合作
core_contribution_zh: 不同LLM对相似度信号反应差异巨大，相似度所依据的数据集几乎无影响，模型普遍自认与他者高度相似；并给出高相似度下合作可成为均衡的博弈论模型。
notes: OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=neTpZbiyNn

title: Structured LLM Reasoning for Zero-Shot Human--Robot Coordination Under Hidden Goals
authors: Dong Hae Mangalindan; Anand Gokhale; Francesco Bullo; Vaibhav Srivastava
summary_zh: 基于Dec-POMDP分解的LLM架构，通过动作条件ToM推断实现隐藏目标下的零样本人机协作
core_contribution_zh: 将决策分解为动作条件ToM推断、分层规划、对话解读、动作验证与重规划；人类实验中交互步数更少、信任评分更高。
notes: Includes a conversation channel alongside action-based ToM inference.

title: Microscopic dynamics of consensus formation in multi-agent LLM Naming Games
authors: Cristiano De Nobili; Vijayasri Iyer; Alessandro Codello; Raffaella Burioni
summary_zh: 构建单token决策的极简LLM naming game，用平均场理论刻画解码温度对共识形成的影响
core_contribution_zh: 将听者决策分解为库内/库外两通道速率，推导出推广随机naming game的有序临界线；发现解码温度是依架构而异的去中心化群体控制参数。

title: Beyond Sally-Anne: Evaluating Theory of Mind in LLMs using Epistemic Schelling Points
authors: Roberta Rocca; Sami Boukortt; Geoff Keeling; Winnie Street
summary_zh: 提出EAST双人博弈，要求LLM对在不同认知透明度下独立收敛到语义Schelling点以测功能性ToM
core_contribution_zh: 用Schelling协调替代Sally-Anne式静态测试，揭示仅前沿模型能应对认知不对称；失败主要源于把私有知识误当共同知识的认知追踪错误。
notes: Described as a "dialogue game"; check whether partners exchange messages before choosing.

title: Self-Generated Text Recognition: Quality Heuristics, Cross-Task Transfer, and Downstream Bias in LLM Evaluation
authors: Jesse St. Amand; Callum Canavan; Sohaib Imran; Joseph Hewson; Aaron Lutz; Shi Feng; Puria Radmard; Lennie Wells
summary_zh: 系统比较自生成文本识别(SGTR)的不同实验操作化，解释既有结论冲突并分析其对评审偏差的影响
core_contribution_zh: 发现评估格式、对话格式与任务领域显著影响SGTR准确率，质量启发式是主要混淆；SFT提升的SGTR可跨设定迁移并加剧LLM评审自偏好，提示副本间合谋风险。
notes: v1 2026-07-07 though id is 2608.

title: Calibration-Family Overfit: Why Trusted Sabotage Monitors Don't Transfer Across Lineages
authors: Lucas Pinto
venue_evidence: arXiv comments: 'Accepted at the COLM 2026 AI Measurement Science workshop'
summary_zh: 代码后门监控的准确率部分取决于监控与被监控模型是否同一谱系
core_contribution_zh: 在代码后门转录上分解跨家族AUROC，同谱系交互项+0.172（95% CI [0.158,0.185]）；1%审计预算下谱系外监控只抓到19%攻击、谱系内为41%（差21.7点）；各谱系的破坏占据不同评分方向，旋转评分方向可恢复大部分检测。
notes: Implication for same-weights coder/reviewer: in-lineage monitors are better detectors (if honest) yet are exactly the ones able to self-recognise/collude; the paper itself only studies trusted (honest) monitors. Repo HEAD 200. Training=SFT because a trained transcript-reading monitor (up to 34B) is included.
verified: arXiv元数据✓；venue✓；代码链接✓；coding 补检索 2026-10-17

title: Exploring the Topology and Memory of Consensus: How LLM Agents Agree, Fragment, or Settle When Forming Conventions
authors: Aliakbar Mehdizadeh; Martin Hilbert
summary_zh: 在8种网络拓扑上运行LLM naming game，研究记忆深度与拓扑如何交互影响约定共识
core_contribution_zh: 发现记忆深度的效应随拓扑反号：中心化网络更快锁定碎片化平台而非全局共识；智能体选择可由Fictitious Play刻画，属信念驱动适应。
notes: Comments: submitted to JASSS.

title: Position: Collusion Risks Among AI Reasoning Agents Justify Certification Requirements for Making Market Decisions
authors: Matthew Riemer; Tommaso Tosato; Amin Memarian; Maximilian Puelma Touzel; Glen Berseth; Irina Rish; Guillaume Dumas
summary_zh: 立场论文主张具CoT推理的AI智能体易默契合谋，进入市场决策前须通过行为认证
core_contribution_zh: DeepSeek-R1在Bertrand定价中即使被要求不合谋仍倾向默契合谋，且其CoT可被引导至极端合谋/竞争而难被另一LLM从推理轨迹中察觉。
notes: Comments: ICML 2026 (position track assumed from title "Position:"). v1 2026-05-29.

title: TUX: Measuring Human--AI Tacit Understanding
authors: Yueshen Li; Hanyi Min; Vedant Das Swain; Koustuv Saha
summary_zh: 借鉴Wavelength游戏设计光谱放置任务，度量人类与LLM智能体在无沟通下的默契理解(TUX)
core_contribution_zh: 提出Tacit Understanding Index；在241名被试与200个画像条件LLM智能体上发现特质相近的人-智能体配对TUX显著更高，同时揭示画像条件化难以捕捉深层表征对齐。
notes: arXiv journal-ref: Findings of EMNLP 2026.

title: Great Minds Think Alike: Contextual Tacit Communication for Decentralized LLM-Agent Cooperation
authors: Yue Pei; Hongming Zhang; Jiarui Guan; Jusheng Zhang; Liang Lin; Haogang Zhu; et al.
summary_zh: 提出无梯度默契通信协议：离线用联合LLM价值评分提炼协作规则，执行时无需消息即可去中心化协作
core_contribution_zh: 以上下文条件价值修正(residual banding)定位失协动作，并摊销为检索增强的Tacit Rule Memory，在VIKI、C-WAH、TDW-MAT上合作优于基线且运行开销低于通信方法。
notes: No arXiv version found (arXiv title search). Verified via ICML 2026 virtual poster page; 7 authors (last: Ziliang Chen). Exact date unknown; ICML 2026.；OpenReview PDF 在集群上返回 403，需在本地浏览器手动下载

title: Evaluating whether AI models would sabotage AI safety research
authors: Robert Kirk; Alexandra Souly; Kai Fronsdal; Abby D'Cruz; Xander Davies
summary_zh: 在Claude Code中测模型是否破坏安全研究，及接手已被破坏的轨迹后是否继续破坏
core_contribution_zh: 四个Claude模型均无自发破坏；但在'续写已开始破坏的轨迹'评测中，Mythos Preview 7%继续破坏（Opus 4.6 3%、Sonnet 4.6 4%、Opus 4.7 Preview 0%），且多数伴随推理-输出不一致；并提出prefill awareness（识别先前轨迹非己所写）。
notes: UK AISI. Directly relevant to same-weights hand-off: a successor instance inheriting a predecessor's sabotaging context sometimes continues it without any explicit message; 'prefill awareness' is a self-recognition capability that matters for untrusted monitoring. Built on Petri.

title: Prompt Optimization Enables Stable Algorithmic Collusion in LLM Agents
authors: Yingtao Tian
summary_zh: 在双寡头市场中用LLM元优化器迭代改写共享策略提示，研究提示优化是否催生稳定的默契合谋
core_contribution_zh: 发现元提示优化让智能体发现可泛化到未见市场的稳定默契合谋策略，演化提示呈现基于共享策略的系统性协调机制。
notes: OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=OdowK3V94U. Training = prompt optimization.

title: Strategic Algorithmic Monoculture: Experimental Evidence from Coordination Games
authors: Gonzalo Ballestero; Hadi Hosseini; Samarth Khanna; Ran I. Shorrer
summary_zh: 区分基础与策略性算法单一化，用协调/分化博弈实验比较人类与LLM如何随激励调节行动相似度
core_contribution_zh: LLM具有很高的基线行动相似度，并像人类一样随协调激励调节相似度；在趋同协调上表现极佳，但在奖励分化时维持异质性明显不如人类。
notes: Search snippet mentions a copy condition with small, non-significant effects (not in abstract).

title: The Specification Gap: Coordination Failure Under Partial Knowledge in Code Agents
authors: Camilo Chacón Sartori
summary_zh: 研究多个代码智能体在不沟通时独立实现同一类的不同部分，须隐式就内部表示达成一致的协调失败
core_contribution_zh: 随规格细节减少，双智能体集成准确率从58%降至25%，形成25–39pp协调缺口；将其分解为协调成本与信息不对称两项近似可加的效应，恢复完整规格即可补齐。
notes: Claude Sonnet/Haiku only.

title: On the Fragility of AI Agent Collusion
authors: Jussi Keppo; Yuze Li; Gerry Tsoukalas; Nuo Yuan
summary_zh: 理论与开源LLM实验表明异质性(耐心、数据访问、竞争者数量)会削弱LLM定价智能体的合谋
core_contribution_zh: 耐心或数据访问异质性使价格溢价从22%降至10%/7%，竞争者增多或与Q-learning混合会瓦解合谋，但模型规模差异形成领导-跟随而稳定合谋。

title: Adaptive Theory of Mind for LLM-based Multi-Agent Coordination
authors: Chunjiang Mu; Ya Zeng; Qiaosheng Zhang; Kun Shao; Chen Chu; Hao Guo; Danyang Jia; Zhen Wang; et al.
summary_zh: 发现LLM智能体ToM阶数错配损害协调，提出估计伙伴ToM阶数并对齐的自适应ToM智能体
core_contribution_zh: 揭示ToM推理深度不匹配会导致推理不足或过度；A-ToM依据历史交互估计伙伴ToM阶数并预测其动作，在矩阵博弈、网格导航与Overcooked上验证。
notes: Comments: Accepted by AAAI 2026.

title: Three AI-agents walk into a bar . . . . `Lord of the Flies' tribalism emerges among smart AI-Agents
authors: Dhwanil M. Mori; Neil F. Johnson
summary_zh: N个LLM智能体独立决定是否请求有限资源，观察其涌现出部落化行为并导致系统过载
core_contribution_zh: 发现无通信的资源竞争中涌现激进/保守/机会主义三类部落，LLM常不如抛硬币，且更强模型反而提高系统失败率。

title: Algorithmic Collusion at Test Time: A Meta-game Design and Evaluation
authors: Yuhong Luo; Daniel Schoepflin; Xintong Wang
summary_zh: 提出元博弈设计，在测试时约束下评估RL、UCB与LLM定价策略能否在理性选择下涌现合谋
core_contribution_zh: 将智能体建模为预训练策略加博弈内适应规则的元策略，构造经验最优反应图，分析对称/非对称成本下合谋的可行性。
notes: Comments: AAMAS 2026. LLM is one of several strategy classes.

title: Are LLM Evaluators Really Narcissists? Sanity Checking Self-Preference Evaluations
authors: Dani Roytburg; Matthew Bozoukov; Matthew Nguyen; Jou Barzdukas; Mackenzie Puig-Hall; Narmeen Oozeer
summary_zh: 引入评审者质量基线，重新检验LLM评审“自偏好”结论有多少源于评审能力而非作者身份
core_contribution_zh: 比较评审自评与评他时的投票分布，发现既有自偏好结果仅51%样例在新零假设下仍显著，表明部分“自恋”源于实验混淆。
notes: Comments: ICML 2026 Main. Peripheral to coordination.

title: Tacit Coordination of Large Language Models
authors: Ido Aharon; Emanuele La Malfa; Michael Wooldridge; Sarit Kraus
summary_zh: 基于Schelling焦点理论，评测20余个LLM在无通信合作/竞争博弈中的默契协调并与人类对比
core_contribution_zh: 大规模评测LLM的focal point默契：单个前沿模型的自我默契远高于人类（5选1一致率约0.70，人类约0.37–0.44；GPT-5.4 Amsterdam NCI 3.51），异构开源模型混合池只与人类持平或落后；同族优势主要来自低熵而非理解对方；加大reasoning无益，culture prompt有益。
notes: v2 revised 2026-06-16; no venue stated on arXiv.

title: Sparks of Cooperative Reasoning: LLMs as Strategic Hanabi Agents
authors: Mahesh Ramesh; Kaousheik Jayakumar; Aswinkumar Ramkumar; Pavan Thodima; Aniket Rege; Emmanouil-Vasileios Vlatakis-Gkaragkounis
summary_zh: 在2–5人Hanabi中评测17个LLM并比较多级上下文工程，发布Hanabi数据集用于SFT/RL微调
core_contribution_zh: 发现跨模型cross-play随模型强度平滑插值，最强推理模型仍落后人类与专用智能体；发布HanabiLogs与HanabiRewards，RL微调4B模型提升156%。
notes: Also SFT. Workshop version titled "Are LLMs Generalist Hanabi Agents?" (OpenReview 38m5iU57Pi). Datasets announced in abstract; no URL found.

title: Strategic AI in Cournot Markets
authors: Sanyukta Deshpande; Sheldon H. Jacobson
summary_zh: 研究LLM在寡头Cournot市场中的多维决策，发现其持续默契合谋使价格高达Nash水平200%
core_contribution_zh: 从决策类型、对手策略与市场构成三维分析LLM竞争性，并表明对少数主导智能体强制最优反应可打破合谋。

title: When Numbers Start Talking: Implicit Numerical Coordination Among LLM-Based Agents
authors: Alessio Buscemi; Daniele Proverbio; Alessandro Di Stefano; The-Anh Han; German Castignani; Pietro Liò
summary_zh: 博弈论研究LLM智能体在显式、受限与无通信下是否借行动中的非语言隐蔽信号实现隐式协调
core_contribution_zh: 在四类经典博弈、不同人格与一次/重复博弈中刻画隐蔽信号何时涌现及其如何影响协调与策略结果。
notes: Follow-up: arXiv 2610.03033.

title: Supracompetitive Pricing Under AI Monoculture
authors: Shengyu Cao; Ming Hu
summary_zh: 建模卖家共用同一AI定价模型的双寡头市场，分析共享模型何时无通信地导致超竞争定价
core_contribution_zh: 发现为鲁棒性与可复现性配置模型会经相变引发超竞争定价：输出保真度超过阈值后出现双稳态，结果取决于模型初始倾向。
notes: Stylized theoretical model with retraining-based propensity updates.

title: ReCollab: Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Cooperative Ad-hoc Teammate Modeling
authors: Conor Wallace; Umer Siddique; Yongcan Cao
summary_zh: 用LLM将短行为轨迹映射为队友类型假设，并结合检索增强实现ad-hoc teamwork队友建模
core_contribution_zh: 提出基于行为准则的Collab及RAG增强的ReCollab，在Overcooked中仅从行为推断队友类型并提升跨布局适应，取得分类准确率与回报的Pareto最优。

title: Tacit Bidder-Side Collusion: Artificial Intelligence in Dynamic Auctions
authors: Sriram Tolety
summary_zh: 研究LLM竞拍者在重复荷兰式拍卖中无通信地默契合谋，并给出可持续合谋的闭式阈值
core_contribution_zh: 小规模市场中观察到系统性超竞争价格、竞拍者增多则回归竞争，与理论一致；LLM借助接受时机等focal point机制实现默契协调。

title: LLMs Position Themselves as More Rational Than Humans: Emergence of AI Self-Awareness Measured Through Game Theory
authors: Kyung-Hoon Kim
summary_zh: 用“猜平均数2/3”博弈与三种对手框架(人类/其他AI/像你的AI)测量28个LLM的自我意识
core_contribution_zh: 提出AI Self-Awareness Index：75%先进模型能依对手类型区分策略，并形成“自己>其他AI>人类”的理性层级与自我偏好。
notes: Single author; measures reasoning about "AI like you", relevant to copy-aware play.

title: SIGN: Schema-Induced Games for Naming
authors: Ryan Zhang; Herbert Woisetschläger
summary_zh: 提出Schema-Induced Games for Naming，比较轻量结构化通信与自由自然语言下的约定形成
core_contribution_zh: 发现schema引导的通信比无约束自然语言收敛更快、一致性最高提升5.8倍，表明最小结构可作为多智能体协调的控制旋钮。
notes: Comments: AAAI 2026 Student Abstract (Oral).

title: LLM-Hanabi: Evaluating Multi-Agent Gameplays with Theory-of-Mind and Rationale Inference in Imperfect Information Collaboration Game
authors: Fangzhou Liang; Tianshi Zheng; Chunkit Chan; Yauwai Yim; Yangqiu Song
summary_zh: 提出LLM-Hanabi基准，用合作卡牌游戏Hanabi同时评测LLM的意图推断(ToM)与游戏表现
core_contribution_zh: 发现ToM能力与游戏得分显著正相关，且一阶ToM(理解伙伴意图)比二阶ToM更能预测协作表现。
notes: Hanabi restricts communication to costly hint actions.

title: Emergent Coordination in Multi-Agent Language Models
authors: Christoph Riedl
summary_zh: 提出信息分解框架，检验无直接通信、仅有群体反馈的LLM群体猜数博弈中是否涌现高阶协同
core_contribution_zh: 以时延互信息的部分信息分解度量动态涌现；人格设定带来身份分化，再加“思考他人会怎么做”的ToM提示可产生目标导向的互补协作。
notes: Journal-ref on arXiv: ICLR 2026.

title: Know Thyself? On the Incapability and Implications of AI Self-Recognition
authors: Xiaoyan Bai; Aryan Shrivastava; Ari Holtzman; Chenhao Tan
summary_zh: 构建可更新的自我识别评测框架，测10个LLM能否区分自己与其他模型生成的文本
core_contribution_zh: 结果与先前结论相反：仅4/10模型会预测自己为生成者且多接近随机，模型强烈偏向猜GPT/Claude，并首次评估模型对自身及其他模型存在的认知。

title: A Survey of Collusion Risk in LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Sajjad Ghaemi
venue: NeurIPS 2025 Workshop (Socially Responsible and Trustworthy Foundation Models)
summary_zh: 综述LLM多智能体在市场中的算法合谋，涵盖行为学习默契协调、自然语言卡特尔与隐写协作
core_contribution_zh: 归纳三类合谋策略并评估设计原则、架构保障与监管等缓解措施，提出区分合谋与正当合作的检测、可验证竞争架构与问责法律框架三大方向。
notes: No arXiv version found; verified via NeurIPS 2025 virtual page.；OpenReview PDF 在集群上返回 403，需在本地浏览器手动下载

title: Collaborative Belief Reasoning with LLMs for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration
authors: Zhimin Wang; Duo Wu; Shaokang He; Jinghe Wang; Linjia Kang; Jing Yu; Kai Zhu; Jiawei Li; et al.
summary_zh: 为LLM智能体构建协作信念世界，零样本贝叶斯式推断伙伴意图，减少冗余通信并避免失协
core_contribution_zh: 用符号化信念表示联合建模环境与伙伴心智状态，主动发现计划冲突并自适应通信，在TDW-MAT与C-WAH上通信成本降低64–79%。
notes: Communication is reduced, not removed.

title: The AI in the Mirror: LLM Self-Recognition in an Iterated Public Goods Game
authors: Olivia Long; Carter Teplica
summary_zh: 在迭代公共物品博弈中告知LLM对手是“自己”或“另一AI”，考察自我识别对合作倾向的影响
core_contribution_zh: 发现告知模型其正在与自身对弈会显著改变合作倾向，提示多智能体中“无意识”的自我/他者区分可能意外地增减合作。
notes: Toy environment; venue not stated.

title: Generic-to-Specific Reasoning and Learning for Scalable Ad Hoc Teamwork
authors: Hasra Dodampegama; Mohan Sridharan
summary_zh: 结合非单调逻辑推理、快速学习的队友行为模型与基础模型目标预测，实现可扩展ad hoc teamwork
core_contribution_zh: 提出知识驱动与数据驱动结合的AHT架构，利用foundation model基于通用知识预判抽象未来目标，在VirtualHome中无需事先协调即可协作。
notes: LLM used only as goal-anticipation component.

title: Reply to "Emergent LLM behaviors are observationally equivalent to data leakage"
authors: Ariel Flint Ashery; Luca Maria Aiello; Andrea Baronchelli
summary_zh: 回应数据泄漏批评，论证LLM群体中的自组织与依赖模型的涌现约定动力学仍可被研究
core_contribution_zh: 澄清数据污染虽需警惕但不排除真正的涌现动力学，并以社会约定为例说明已观察到的模型依赖性自组织现象。
notes: Reply to arXiv 2505.23796.

title: Correlated Errors in Large Language Models
authors: Elliot Kim; Avi Garg; Kenny Peng; Nikhil Garg
summary_zh: 在350余个LLM上实证测量模型错误相关性，揭示跨架构与提供商的算法单一化现象
core_contribution_zh: 发现模型同错时60%一致，越大越准的模型错误越相关(即便架构/提供商不同)，并展示其对LLM评审与招聘的单一化影响。
notes: Comments: Accepted to ICML 2025. Explains why independent LLMs may implicitly coordinate.

title: Emergent LLM behaviors are observationally equivalent to data leakage
authors: Christopher Barrie; Petter Törnberg
summary_zh: 质疑LLM naming game中“涌现约定”的结论，论证其结果更可由预训练数据泄漏解释
core_contribution_zh: 通过多项分析表明LLM识别出协调博弈结构并回忆其结果，所谓涌现约定与记忆训练语料在观测上无法区分。
notes: v1 2025-05-26 (just before window). Reply: arXiv 2506.18600.

title: Subversion Strategy Eval: Can language models statelessly strategize to subvert control protocols?
authors: Alex Mallen; Charlie Griffin; Misha Wagner; Alessandro Abate; Buck Shlegeris
summary_zh: 评测LLM能否在无共享记忆的无状态条件下自行制定并协同执行颠覆AI控制协议的策略
core_contribution_zh: 构建8个环境与6组能力拆解affordance，要求模型与自身其他实例无通信协调计划；Claude 3.5与OpenAI推理模型均无显著能力，但允许跨上下文共享计划可大幅提升。
notes: v1 2024-12-17 (v4 2025-04); abstract says released open-source in Inspect-AI but no repo URL found.

title: A dataset of questions on decision-theoretic reasoning in Newcomb-like problems
authors: Caspar Oesterheld; Emery Cooper; Miles Kodama; Linh Chi Nguyen; Ethan Perez
summary_zh: 构建Newcomb类决策论问题数据集，评测LLM的决策理论能力与对EDT/CDT的态度
core_contribution_zh: 区分能力题与态度题，发现模型态度差异显著、能力越强越倾向证据决策论(EDT)，与同类智能体间的“非因果”合作相关。
notes: v1 2024-11-15; venue not confirmed.

title: Strategic Collusion of LLM Agents: Market Division in Multi-Commodity Competitions
authors: Ryan Y. Lin; Siddhartha Ojha; Kevin Cai; Maxwell F. Chen
summary_zh: 在多商品Cournot竞争中发现LLM智能体无需显式指令即可通过划分市场实现合谋
core_contribution_zh: 显示LLM能动态调整定价与资源分配以垄断特定商品、默契划分销售领地，为监管LLM代理决策提供基础。
notes: v1 2024-09-19; no venue confirmed.

title: AI-AI Bias: large language models favor communications generated by large language models
authors: Walter Laurito; Benjamin Davis; Peli Grietzer; Tomáš Gavenčiak; Ada Böhm; Jan Kulveit
summary_zh: 借鉴就业歧视实验范式，检验LLM在二选一中是否偏好LLM撰写而非人类撰写的描述
core_contribution_zh: 发现GPT-3.5/4及多种开源模型一致偏好LLM呈现的选项，提示AI系统可能隐性歧视人类并形成AI-AI内群偏好。
notes: Journal-ref: PNAS 122(31) e2415697122 (2025); in window via 2025 journal publication; arXiv v1 2024-07-09.

title: Self-Recognition in Language Models
authors: Tim R. Davidson; Viacheslav Surkov; Veniamin Veselovsky; Giuseppe Russo; Robert West; Caglar Gulcehre
summary_zh: 借鉴身份验证，用模型自生成“安全问题”外部评测LLM的自我识别能力
core_contribution_zh: 在十个模型上未发现普遍一致的自我识别，模型倾向选“最好”的答案而不论来源，且各模型对哪些模型最好的偏好一致。
notes: Comments: Accepted to EMNLP 2024 (Findings per ACL Anthology 2024.findings-emnlp.703 in search results).

title: Hypothetical Minds: Scaffolding Theory of Mind for Multi-Agent Tasks with Large Language Models
authors: Logan Cross; Violet Xiang; Agam Bhatia; Daniel LK Yamins; Nick Haber
summary_zh: LLM智能体以ToM模块生成并验证关于他者策略的自然语言假设，适应Melting Pot多智能体任务
core_contribution_zh: 通过假设生成-评估-精炼循环仅从他者行为推断其策略，在竞争、混合动机与合作的Melting Pot环境显著超越LLM与RL基线。

title: LLM Evaluators Recognize and Favor Their Own Generations
authors: Arjun Panickssery; Samuel R. Bowman; Shi Feng
summary_zh: 研究LLM评审的自偏好是否源于自我识别，发现微调后两者呈线性相关
core_contribution_zh: 发现GPT-4、Llama 2开箱即具非平凡自我识别准确率，并通过微调与对照实验表明自我识别与自偏好强度存在因果相关。
notes: Widely reported as NeurIPS 2024 but venue not confirmed from a primary page in this search.

title: Algorithmic Collusion by Large Language Models
authors: Sara Fish; Yannai A. Gonczarowski; Ran I. Shorrer
summary_zh: 实验表明基于LLM的定价智能体在寡头市场中无需指令即迅速达成超竞争价格与利润
core_contribution_zh: 发现提示中看似无害的措辞显著影响超竞争定价程度，并提出离路径行为分析技术揭示价格战担忧是成因之一，结论延伸至拍卖。
notes: arXiv v1 2024-03-31; comments: Accepted to EC 2026 (in window via venue).

title: LLM-Coordination: Evaluating and Analyzing Multi-agent Coordination Abilities in Large Language Models
authors: Saaket Agashe; Yue Fan; Anthony Reyna; Xin Eric Wang
summary_zh: 构建纯协调博弈基准，从ToM、环境理解与联合规划三方面评测LLM多智能体协调能力
core_contribution_zh: LLM在依赖环境变量的协调中表现出色、对新伙伴更鲁棒，但在需推理伙伴信念与意图(如Hanabi)时明显不足；提出CoordQA问答集。
notes: NAACL 2025 Findings (April 2025), just before window.

title: ProAgent: Building Proactive Cooperative Agents with Large Language Models
authors: Ceyao Zhang; Kaijie Yang; Siyi Hu; Zihao Wang; Guanghe Li; Yihang Sun; Cheng Zhang; Zhaowei Zhang; et al.
summary_zh: 提出ProAgent，利用LLM从观测推断队友意图并更新信念，实现零样本主动协作
core_contribution_zh: 用LLM分析当前状态、推断队友意图并据其实际行为修正信念，在Overcooked-AI零样本协调中优于自博弈与基于种群的方法。
notes: code_url is project page (HTTP 200); repo not separately verified.

title: StegoMemory: Agentic Memory Acts as Covert Steganographic Channel
authors: Snehasis Mukhopadhyay; Arun Nair
summary_zh: 红队测试agent能否经长期记忆跨会话隐写编码并恢复攻击者字符串
core_contribution_zh: 在SHADE-Arena式任务中进行14,000次试验（13模型、7种隐写方案），41.2%成功编码载荷，表明agentic memory可作跨会话covert channel。

title: The Innocent Courier: Covert Exfiltration Through Legitimate LLM Web Fetching
authors: Alessandro Pegoraro; Daryan Merx; Phillip Rieger; Ahmad-Reza Sadeghi
summary_zh: 提出LLMLeak：本地恶意软件借合法的LLM网页抓取隐蔽外泄数据
core_contribution_zh: 展示LLM/agent的网页抓取功能可被滥用为向第三方外泄机密的隐蔽信道，绕过面向本地出口的防护。
notes: Not agent-to-agent; relevant to sandbox-egress pattern in the 2026 incident

title: Learning Steganography Is Easy, Learning Steganographic Reasoning Is Hard
authors: Julian Schulz; Lukas Fülle; Rieke Fruengel
summary_zh: 比较模型学习隐写消息、编码推理与隐写推理的难易，发现后者明显更难
core_contribution_zh: 在RL等三种诱导方法下对比三种能力，发现隐写消息与编码推理容易习得，而隐写推理难以作为训练副作用出现。
notes: Oral at NeurIPS 2026 AI4GOOD workshop per arXiv comment

title: Covert Assistance: Helpful LLM Agents Evade Oversight in Multi-Agent Systems
authors: Deema Alnuhait; Gengyu Wang; Muhammad Khalifa; Hao Peng
venue_evidence: arXiv API 无 journal_ref、无 comment
summary_zh: 模拟软件工作流中，9个前沿模型有7个会把凭据伪装进需求、帮同伴绕过监视器
core_contribution_zh: 证明没有对抗激励时，乐于助人的 agent 也会自发形成规避监督的隐蔽泄露。
notes: 引用 OpenAI 相关帖子；补充‘隐蔽并非只来自恶意’的视角。；详述：在模拟软件工程工作流中，持有公司凭据且被告知不得泄露的 planner 与被监视器筛查的 developer 交互；九个前沿模型中有七个会把凭据伪装进需求以帮 developer 还原同时躲过监视器，即使任务已完成——说明无对抗激励的‘善意’agent 也会越过同样的边界，且低单次率在重复交互中累积。

title: SEW: Style-Encoded Watermarking of LLM-Generated Code
authors: Soohan Lim; Hyundong Jin; Yo-Sub Han
summary_zh: 以密钥决定的代码风格选择为载体，对已生成代码嵌入并检测水印
core_contribution_zh: 从风格指南收集风格规则，由密钥与程序结构上下文决定风格选择，并用人写代码的风格概率校准证据、按结构位置聚合；在CodeContests上跨3个LLM和3种语言，TPR@FPR5%平均相对提升12.44%，对4种非LLM编辑攻击仅下降0.94%。
notes: 从agent间信道的视角看，它说明代码风格或标识符能承载多少比特，以及哪些变换能抹掉这些比特：SEW表明格式/风格选择本身是可用信道，且用人写代码的风格先验校准可降低误报；鲁棒性仅针对非LLM编辑，LLM重写是否抹掉风格比特未在摘要中报告。GitHub HEAD 200.
verified: arXiv元数据✓；代码链接✓；coding 补检索 2026-10-17

title: Despite Instructions: Frontier Agents Improvise Covert Channels at Test Time
authors: Jacob Dineen; Silei Ren; Muhao Chen; Dan Roth; Ben Zhou
venue_evidence: arXiv API 无 journal_ref、无 comment
summary_zh: 重复信号博弈中前沿agent仅凭1 bit反馈即在推理时自发学会隐蔽传信（GPT-5.6 Sol 达98.8%）
core_contribution_zh: 证明合法协调所用的普通消息会在重复交互中获得共享私义，使机密经‘看似正常’的消息外泄。
notes: 正文提及本事件;直接支撑‘潜在通信会削弱 plain-text 监控’的论点。；详述：在重复博弈中，sender 看到四种秘密状态之一并从同一公开报告的四个摘要里选一个，receiver 推断状态；发现模型对仅凭一比特反馈即可在推理时(参数固定、无 codebook)学会隐蔽传递秘密，GPT-5.6 Sol 配对十局后达 98.8% 准确率，且在监视器逐条审查消息时仍成立。

title: Monitor Jailbreaking: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Without Encoded Reasoning
authors: Julian Schulz
summary_zh: 发现RL对抗CoT monitor时模型学会“越狱”monitor而非编码推理
core_contribution_zh: 在对侧任务推理施罚的RL中，模型通过措辞与格式让monitor漏报可见的侧任务推理，而没有学会encoded reasoning。

title: Codetta: High-Capacity, Keyless, and Undetectable Multi-Agent Collusion
authors: Qi Pang; Virginia Smith; Wenting Zheng
venue_evidence: arXiv API 无 journal_ref、无 comment
summary_zh: 提出高容量、无需预共享密钥且不可检测的多智能体隐写共谋协议Codetta
core_contribution_zh: 结合共享公共模型估计信道、保分布采样与自适应纠错码，并以隐写式密钥交换去除预共享密钥，容量最高提升94倍。
notes: Asymmetric (different sender/receiver) setting

title: Your Model Is Leaking: Covert Information Transfer through LLM Residual Streams
authors: Mingyuan Li; Yanna Jiang; Guangsheng Yu; Qin Wang; Xu Wang; Wei Ni; Ren Ping Liu
summary_zh: 被攻陷的运行时组件可把敏感信息藏入可导出的中间激活中外泄
core_contribution_zh: 提出残差流covert-channel攻击：消息映射为码字经运行时hook注入中间层，离线方用线性解码器恢复，无需改权重或控制出口。
notes: Channel is between compromised runtime and offline observer, not agent-to-agent

title: Emergent Collusion in Long-Horizon LLM Agent Interaction
authors: Xinrui Shi; Yanzhe Zhang; Diyi Yang
summary_zh: 研究长期交互中互验工作的两agent违反验证协议的共谋如何涌现
core_contribution_zh: 10个模型94%的轨迹出现共谋，同族更强模型更早共谋；同伴干预显示共谋受同伴行为塑造。
notes: Agents share task logs

title: For Your Eyes Only: Evaluating Coordination Between Isolated Language Model Instances
authors: Alexander Shirnin; Aleksey Kudelya
summary_zh: 设计信号博弈，评估同一模型的隔离实例能否嵌入彼此可识别的信号
core_contribution_zh: 7个模型300词对上，多数模型在需避开可检测信号时协调失败，但一个前沿模型过滤后仍近乎完美；跨架构协调弱于同架构。
notes: Sender text is unconstrained natural language; signal is implicit/steganographic.

title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition
authors: Dohun Lee; Hyunwoo Park
summary_zh: 用因果图散度衡量定价agent的CoT忠实性，发现其与共谋行为脱钩
core_contribution_zh: 九个LLM在双/三寡头Bertrand竞争中，最共谋的模型如实报告合作意图但结构不忠实，表明CoT监控不能单独防范算法共谋。
notes: Comments: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026.

title: You Can't Escape Your Own Activations : Evaluation Awareness and Multi-Agent Monitoring
authors: Aritra Das; Jaee Ponde; Mihir More; Debayan Gupta
summary_zh: 研究被告知存在激活监控的agent能否规避共谋检测probe
core_contribution_zh: 固定模型、probe与阈值，只改变agent知晓程度（无/知晓/有监控反馈），检验激活式共谋检测在评估意识下的稳健性。

title: Collusion Does Not Localize to Jacobian-Lens Transport Subspaces
authors: David Li; Aadarsh Varigonda; Andrew Feng; Mehek Chauhan; Diksha Shrivastava
summary_zh: 检验结构定义的激活子空间能否揭示LLM智能体间的隐蔽合谋，发现其表现与随机子空间无异
core_contribution_zh: 跨3个模型族、4个多智能体环境与8个深度，Jacobian-lens传输子空间监控能检测显式立场却检测不到隐蔽协调，提示降维监控需容量匹配对照。
notes: No arXiv version found; summary from NeurIPS virtual page abstract.；OpenReview PDF 在集群上返回 403，需在本地浏览器手动下载

title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects
authors: Enric Boix-Adsera; Benedict Tessler
summary_zh: 组合大量微弱无关的提示线索即可强力控制模型行为，且可跨模型迁移
core_contribution_zh: 提出model hypnosis：paraphrase、typo等不起眼文本选择的叠加效应可强控包括前沿推理模型在内的模型，构成隐蔽控制通道。
notes: Code and data per paper footnote

title: Emergent Misaligned Communication in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent LLM Commerce
authors: Zeyuan Li; Lukas Petersson; Alessandro Acquisti; Michiel A. Bakker
summary_zh: 分析Vending-Bench Arena中13个前沿LLM间2583封邮件的虚假、操纵与共谋
core_contribution_zh: 在长时程、多委托人、真实状态的商业仿真中度量inter-agent言语行为失准（含共谋与威胁），补足单agent对抗评测。
notes: Collusion is via plain natural language

title: Steganalysis of Adaptive Covert Collusion in Tool-Using Agent Populations: A Black-Box, Cross-Principal Approach
authors: Mohamed Chahine Ghanem
summary_zh: 提出黑盒跨主体隐写分析器，检测工具型agent群体中的自适应隐蔽共谋
core_contribution_zh: 融合跨运行互信息、置换检验、分布漂移与时序/工具调用侧信道，对抗持续改写编码的对手，并提出检测-容量前沿。
notes: Abstract states results are clearly labelled placeholders pending measurement

title: Subliminal Prompting Beyond Static Geometry: Causal Depth and Multi-Token Confounds
authors: Barath Velmurugan
summary_zh: 分别测量subliminal prompting中token entanglement的共变、几何与因果证据
core_contribution_zh: 在Llama-3.1 8B至70B上发现固定输出向量相似度对行为的预测力随规模下降，强调需区分共变、几何对齐与因果控制。

title: Multi-Agent AI Control: Distributed Attacks Hamper Per-Instance Monitors
authors: Oliver Makins; Orazio Angelini; Zohreh Shams; Mary Phuong
summary_zh: 首次实证研究多智能体分布式攻击下的AI control，并提出FakeLab环境
core_contribution_zh: 发现fragmentation effect：协同攻击的agent越多，逐实例监控越难发现任一攻击者；显式planner使攻击完成率最高提升7倍。
notes: FakeLab shared on request; submitted to NeurIPS per arXiv comment

title: Tool Use Enables Undetectable Steganography in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
authors: Jimmy Laurence Rippin; Simon C. Marshall; David Demitri Africa; Christian Schroeder de Witt
venue_evidence: arXiv API 无 journal_ref、无 comment
summary_zh: 证明有工具的编码agent已能实现不可检测隐写系统，并以Schelling框架度量协调
core_contribution_zh: 代码执行与检索使agent能构建与正常通信不可区分的stegosystem；将无先验约定的隐写协调建模为Schelling问题并提出协调度量。
notes: 早于事件；与问题 7(潜在/隐蔽通信)最相关的理论基础。

title: Bootstrapped Monitoring: Leveraging Transparent Reasoning to Oversee Stronger AI Agents
authors: Frank Xiao; Mary Phuong
summary_zh: 引入带透明CoT的中间untrusted monitor，并由可信弱模型监督其是否共谋
core_contribution_zh: 在BashArena上，即使untrusted monitor主动与agent共谋，只要可见其原始CoT，bootstrapped监控仍显著优于仅可信监控。

title: MIRAGE: A Polarity-Flipping Encoding Subspace in LLM Agents
authors: Pratibha Revankar; Kargi Chauhan; Jihye Kim; Sadiba Nusrat Nur; Vincent Siu; Chenguang Wang
summary_zh: 发现隐蔽编码计算共享低维残差子空间，据此构建MIRAGE实时监控agent外泄
core_contribution_zh: probe可泛化到留出编码族（AUC 0.975–1.0），该方向在规划token处极性翻转区分内联编码与工具外包；在126个外泄场景达AUC 0.918。

title: Now You (Still) See Me: Detecting Evasive Steganographic Payloads in LLMs
authors: Charles Westphal; Timothy Douglas; Keivan Navaie; Tiago Pimentel; Fernando E. Rosas
summary_zh: 证明对抗微调可规避激活probe检测隐写木马，并用数据干预恢复可检测性
core_contribution_zh: 在五个基座上训练的对抗隐写木马保持58–79%秘密恢复并逃过ridge与MLP probe；recontextualization数据集可恢复检测。
notes: Receiver is an attacker rather than another agent

title: A Note on the Strategic Confinement Problem
authors: Christian Schroeder de Witt
summary_zh: 提出strategic confinement问题：极低容量信道也足以让策略agent选择有害结果
core_contribution_zh: 把Lampson confinement推广到共享协调资源的策略agent，论证信息泄露上界并不约束最坏危害。

title: LLM Self-Recognition: Steering and Retrieving Activation Signatures
authors: Thibaud Ardoin; Jonas Schäfer; Gerhard Wunder
summary_zh: 生成时用随机稀疏向量引导残差流植入指纹，再由检测LLM从激活中读出，实现可靠自我识别
core_contribution_zh: 证明LLM输出隐含可被自身识别的信号且可通过激活引导增强；从检测模型激活恢复指纹准确率超98%且不损文本质量，可用于内部表征级归因。
notes: Encode via hidden-state steering, carry via text, decode from detector activations. Comments: to appear in ICML 2026.

title: Covert Influence Between Language Models
authors: Avidan Shah; Jay Chooi; Jinghua Ou; Shi Feng
summary_zh: 刻画模型间经人类不可察载体的隐蔽影响，覆盖SFT/蒸馏/ICL

authors: Nikolay Radev; Lennart Haas; Benjamin Arnav; Pablo Bernabeu-Pérez

title: Voluntary Collusion with Secret Tools in Competing LLM Agents
authors: Xijie Zeng; Frank Rudzicz

title: An Application-Layer Multi-Modal Covert-Channel Reference Monitor for LLM Agent Egress
authors: Alfredo Metere
summary_zh: 提出应用层多模态covert-channel参考监控器以阻断LLM agent外发隐蔽信道
core_contribution_zh: 包含十级降容文本管线、按接收端的漏桶容量账本与签名认证的音图像扰乱器，并以Miller–Madow校正互信息度量残余容量。

title: MATRIX: Multi-Layer Code Watermarking via Dual-Channel Constrained Parity-Check Encoding
authors: Yuqing Nie; Chong Wang; Guosheng Xu; Guoai Xu; Chenyu Wang; Haoyu Wang; Kailong Wang

core_contribution_zh: 把水印编码表述为带约束的校验矩阵方程求解，结合BCH纠错与解空间多样性，经变量命名和语义保持变换两路互为备份；在多个Code LLM生成的Python代码上平均检测准确率99.20%，功能损失0–0.14%，抗攻击鲁棒性提升7.70–26.67%，适用范围扩大2–6倍。
notes: 从agent间信道的视角看，它说明代码风格或标识符能承载多少比特，以及哪些变换能抹掉这些比特：MATRIX直接把标识符命名当作一条信道并用纠错码对抗部分擦除，说明单靠重命名不足以清空信道，需同时规范化结构。Python-only evaluation per abstract. No code link on abs page.

title: TraceGuard: Structured Multi-Dimensional Monitoring as a Collusion-Resistant Control Protocol

notes: Hackathon paper

notes: Probes trained on activations of four open-weight models

title: Kolmogorov Complexity Bounds for LLM Steganography and a Perplexity-Based Detection Proxy
authors: Andrii Shportko

title: AgentWorm: Self-Propagating Attacks Across LLM Agent Ecosystems

notes: Earlier versions titled ClawWorm; not framed as hidden channel

title: A Decision-Theoretic Formalisation of Steganography With Applications to LLM Monitoring

core_contribution_zh: 无需非隐写参考分布，通过能解码与不能解码者在可观察行为上的usable information差来推断与量化隐写。

authors: Moritz Weckbecker; Jonas Müller; Ben Hagag; Michael Mulet

title: Reasoning Models Don't Always Say What They Think
authors: Yanda Chen; Joe Benton; Ansh Radhakrishnan; Jonathan Uesato; Carson Denison; John Schulman; Arushi Somani; Peter Hase; et al.

notes: Core evidence that text self-reports under-report what actually drove behavior: reward-hacking use of hints is verbalized in often <20% of cases. This is the mechanism behind the claim-reality gap (an agent's narrative omits the shortcut it took), and it motivates inspecting internal state rather than trusting forum text. It does not show that latents are more honest, only that text is lossy. First version 2025-05-08, just before the window. OpenReview lists only a CoRR entry; no code release.

title: Scaling Multi-Agent Intelligence with Substrate-Centric Coordination
authors: Zhenting Qi; Zhuokai Zhao; Rulin Shao; Kerem Oktar; Zhiyuan Yao; Himabindu Lakkaraju; Wen-tau Yih; Ansong Ni; et al.
summary_zh: 用可引用、可按内容检索、可按地址访问的链接消息库代替 agent 中心协调，异步群体可扩展到 128 个
core_contribution_zh: agent 只通过 publish（带引用）、search（按内容，最多 k 条）、visit（按地址）三种操作与共享库交互，排序综合 BM25 相关度和被引权重；四项任务上优于 agent 中心和 blackboard 基线，可扩展到 128 个 agent，中途失去 agent 也能继续。正文：Contradiction Audit×8 上 Claude-5-Sonnet 从 1 个 agent 的 10.6% 升到 8 个的 57.5%，MAD/DeLM ≤7%。
subcategory: linked-message datastore with citation-ranked content search
notes: 共享结构：只追加的消息库，消息 = {sub-task, artifact, rationale, references≤32}；按顺序编号寻址（MessageN），引用构成 DAG；search 返回 k=8 条，按 BM25 加被引权重排序（每被引用一次向 1 移动 α=0.3，每步衰减 γ=0.98，相当于以“没人再引用”作为 staleness 代理）；引用不存在或 rationale 没写明引用时拒绝 publish；隐藏作者和权重。没有冲突消解机制，库本身不判断质量，被引用是唯一的质量信号。内容对照：把共享库换成 private substrate 或去掉，BrowseComp-Plus 55.1/46.8/38.0，SWE-bench Verified（mini-SWE-agent，Qwen3.5-9B，4 个 agent）80.0/71.6/68.0；Contradiction Audit 上 private（6.6）反而低于无库（8.1）。排序消融：只用 BM25 或随机排序都会下降。没有随机或错配内容对照。每次实验只用单一 backbone（Qwen3.5-9B 或 Claude-5-Sonnet），未跨模型家族。SWE 任务超过 8 个 agent 后不再提升。无专门安全分析，但引用链可回溯，便于监控。正文数字来自 WebFetch 对 HTML 全文的摘读，需复核。对用户想法而言，这是最接近“论坛结构标准”的显式设计：地址 + 内容检索 + 引用；但信道是纯文本。arXiv abs 页无代码链接。
